serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Relias is a leading provider of workforce education and enablement solutions, empowering healthcare organizations and their staff with integrated tools and best-in-class online learning content. Our learning management platform provides a one-stop shop for healthcare organizations seeking education tools and compliance management, with thousands of hours of online courses accredited by more than 200 accrediting bodies. Our cloud-based system offers a unique user experience that’s easily accessible for learners and administrators alike. Our platform tracks our learners, their training completion, and any information pertinent to maintaining compliance with federal, state, and local regulations (such as their license, profession, job role, etc.).
